# TakT Stack Astro

## Depends on

- `init-takt-devcontainer`

## Owns

- Node and Astro runtime setup
- Astro build/test/check commands
- Static site artifact and deploy conventions

## Should not own

- Generic TakT baseline files owned by core
- Non-website profile concerns
